overview: STUDYVERSE is a gamified student productivity platform where learners track study sessions, earn XP, complete daily quests, unlock rewards and climb leaderboards.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and keep a personal profile with XP, level, streak and study history
Student dashboard with XP progress, daily goal, study time today, weekly statistics, quests and recent achievements
Study room with a customizable timer, subject selection, session history and daily and weekly reports
Server-verified XP rewards for study sessions, with duplicate rewards and timer manipulation prevented
Daily quests that refresh each day with progress bars and claimable XP rewards
XP store for badges, avatars, profile frames, resources and dashboard customization with purchase history
Three membership plans with XP multipliers, expiry dates and payment verification
Theme store with seven looks, instant preview and apply, and premium themes for Ultimate members
Searchable study library with class, board and subject filters, an in-app PDF viewer and downloads
Website Hub of educational site shortcuts that open in a new tab
Global, weekly, monthly and friends leaderboards with avatars, levels and XP
Six unlockable achievement badges driven by real activity
Secure admin dashboard for students, materials, quests, store items, themes, memberships, website links and analytics
Light and dark mode with sidebar navigation on desktop and mobile navigation on the go
